services.name: Tandem Details
services.desc: From Kitchener, Waterloo, or Cambridge, you're one easy highway run from jumping out of a plane at 11,000 feet. Trade the tech-corridor grind for up to 40 seconds of freefall over Lake Ontario. Skydive SWOOP in Dundas is the closest full-service dropzone to the tri-cities - no need to drive past Toronto to Innisfil. From Kitchener or Waterloo you're about 45 minutes out; from Cambridge, closer to 35. Drive out in the morning, freefall over the Niagara Escarpment, and be back the same afternoon. We've jumped Ontario skies since 1979 as Canada's longest-running skydiving club - non-profit, member-run, 3,000+ jumps a year, and rated 4.9 stars across 310 reviews.
